Wii Party (native) - controls
=============================

All four players can play on one keyboard. Gamepads (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch) work too:
plug one in and it becomes the next free player, on top of that player's keys.

                Player 1          Player 2     Player 3     Player 4 (numpad)
  Up/Down/      Arrow keys        W A S D      I J K L      8 4 5 6
  Left/Right
  A             Enter, Space,     Q            U            7
                left mouse click
  B             Backspace,        E            O            9
                Right Ctrl,
                right mouse click
  A+B together  Tab,              C            ,            2
                middle mouse click
  1             1                 Z            N            1
  2             2                 X            M            3
  +             =                 3            8            +
  -             -                                           -
  HOME          H
  Shake         Right Shift       R            P            0

Pointer
  Player 1 points with the mouse. Every player can also move their pointer with their
  direction keys (player 1 with the arrow keys once the mouse has been still for 3 seconds).

F1   Switches the direction keys between "pointing at the screen" and "Remote held sideways".
     Most minigames hold the Remote sideways; press F1 when up/down/left/right feel turned.
     The title bar shows which mode is on.
F11  Full screen on/off.

Gamepad
  A / Cross = A, B / Circle = B, X = 1, Y = 2, Start = +, Back = -, Guide = HOME,
  D-pad = D-pad, right stick = pointer, left stick = tilt, left shoulder = shake,
  right shoulder = B.

The title bar also shows the frame rate.
